Interviewer: Bill Kirchner with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 110 pp.
. . .Two thousand eleven, and we’re in Lee Konitz’s apartment in Manhattan, and I’m Bill Kirchner, and we’re about to begin the oral history with Lee.
Let’s start with the most obvious possible thing.
I was born at a very early age.
We have that in common among other things.
